prompt: In the Splice project {project}, cut the person in the screen take out of their background and blur what is behind them, give the whole video a warmer and more saturated color grade, and add a half-second dissolve into the end card. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: background blurred
checks.expr: any(e['type'] == 'cutout' and e['params'].get('background', 'remove') == 'blur' for c in take_clips() for e in c['effects'])

checks.name: warmer
checks.expr: any((e['params'].get('temperature') or 0) > 0 for e in project['effects'] + [e for c in clips for e in c['effects']] if e['type'] == 'color')

checks.name: more saturated
checks.expr: any((e['params'].get('saturation') or 1) > 1 for e in project['effects'] + [e for c in clips for e in c['effects']] if e['type'] == 'color')

checks.name: dissolve into end card
checks.expr: any(e['type'] == 'transition' and e['params'].get('kind', 'dissolve') == 'dissolve' and 10 <= e['params'].get('length', 15) <= 20 for c in clips if c['media'] == 'med_endcard' for e in c['effects'])
